Metadata.description: Track every job application, interview and follow-up in one place.

Home.intro: Sekka keeps every job application in one place and tells you when to follow up, until someone says yes.

road.label: A road through the stages of a job search: wishlist, applied, screening, interviewing, offer, and finally a yes

board.title: Every application on one board
board.body: From applied to offer, see your whole search at a glance.

reminders.title: Never forget a follow-up
reminders.body: A morning email tells you who to follow up with today.

insights.title: Learn what works
insights.body: See which sources get you interviews and how fast companies reply.

Home.deleted: Your account and all its data have been deleted.

NotFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Free. Start tracking your applications in a minute.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses that email, a link to reset the password is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.done: Your password is changed. Log in with the new one.
reset.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.done: Your email is confirmed. Thank you!
verify.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again.

google.unavailable: Google sign-in couldn't load. Use your email and password instead, or try again later.

Errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match.
Errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.
Errors.too_many_login_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
Errors.too_many_reset_requests: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
Errors.too_many_emails: We've sent several emails already. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
Errors.invalid_google_token: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again.
Errors.google_token_expired: The Google sign-in took too long. Try again.
Errors.google_email_not_verified: Google hasn't confirmed this account's email address, so we can't use it.
Errors.google_account_mismatch: This email's account is linked to a different Google account.
Errors.google_unavailable: We couldn't reach Google. Try again in a moment.
Errors.google_sign_in_not_configured: Google sign-in isn't available right now. Use your email and password.
Errors.invalid_verification_token: This link has already been used or isn't valid. Log in and ask for a new one.
Errors.verification_token_expired: This link has expired. Log in and ask for a new one.
Errors.invalid_reset_token: This link has already been used or isn't valid. Ask for a new one.
Errors.reset_token_expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
Errors.validation_error: Check the fields and try again.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.comingSoon: Your applications board is coming next. You'll be able to add and track applications here.
Dashboard.verifyBanner: Confirm your email address: we sent a link to {email}.
Dashboard.resent: Sent. Check your inbox (and spam folder).

Applications.count: {count, plural, =0 {No applications} one {# application} other {# applications}}

empty.title: No applications yet
empty.body: Add the jobs you've applied to (or want to) and follow each one from here.

Applications.truncated: Showing your 500 newest applications. Use the list to see the rest.

card.dragHint: Drag a card to a highlighted column, or use its menu.

ApplicationForm.job_urlHint: The job post, so you can find it again
ApplicationForm.follow_up_onHint: You'll get a reminder that morning
ApplicationForm.deleteWarning: This deletes the application with its history and interviews. It can't be undone.

invalid.job_url: Enter a full link starting with https://
invalid.salary_max: Enter a whole number at least as big as “From”.

move.title: Next step

followUp.hint: You'll get a reminder email that morning.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.languageHint: Reminder and account emails come in this language.
preferences.timezoneHint: Interview times are shown in it, and reminder emails arrive in its morning.
preferences.remindersHint: On days when a follow-up is due, one email at 8:00.

password.title: Password
password.googleOnly: You sign in with Google. To also sign in with your email and a password, we'll email you a link to set one.
password.sent: Check your inbox: the link to set a password works for 30 minutes.
password.change: To change your password, log out and use “Forgot your password?”.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.body: Tell us what works, what doesn't, and what you'd like next. It takes a minute and goes straight to the people building Sekka.

data.title: Your data
data.body: Download everything we store about you: your profile, applications, their history and interviews (JSON).

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: This deletes your account and all your applications, history and interviews right away. It can't be undone.
delete.googleConfirm: Confirm by signing in with Google again:

app.title: App
app.body: Add {app} to your home screen. It opens full screen, like an app.
app.ios: In Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
app.manual: In your browser's menu, choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

FollowUps.title: Follow-ups
FollowUps.intro: Applications you planned to check on. Send a short message, then mark it done or snooze it.
FollowUps.overdueBy: {days, plural, one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}

empty.title: Nothing to follow up on
empty.body: Set a follow-up date on an application and it shows up here on that day. You also get a reminder email that morning.

funnel.title: Funnel
funnel.note: Of the applications you applied to, how many got further. A rejection counts as a reply.
funnel.none: Nothing applied to yet. Move an application to Applied to start the funnel.

bySource.title: By source
bySource.note: Where your applications came from, and which sources lead to offers.

timeInStage.title: Time in each stage
timeInStage.note: Average days before an application moved on, from your history.
timeInStage.none: Not enough history yet. This fills in as your applications move between stages.
timeInStage.days: {days} days on average · {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}

empty.title: No stats yet
empty.body: Add your applications and your funnel, response rate and best sources show up here.

Unsubscribe.title: Stop reminder emails?
Unsubscribe.description: You won't get the morning email about follow-ups any more. Emails about your account, like password resets, still come.
Unsubscribe.done: Done. You won't get reminder emails any more.
Unsubscribe.settings: Turn them back on in settings
Unsubscribe.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email, or turn off reminders in your settings.

Legal.contactNoEmail: To download or delete your data, go to Settings.
Legal.agree: By creating an account, you agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

add.title: Add your first application
add.body: A job you applied to, or one you want to apply to.

followUp.title: Set a follow-up date
followUp.body: Pick a day to check in with the company. Sekka emails you that morning.

extension.title: Save jobs in one click
extension.body: Add the Sekka extension to Chrome on your computer, then save jobs straight from LinkedIn, Wuzzuf and other sites.
